verdict.rationale: Kit ships 'Unlimited Visual Automations' as a core paid feature and webhooks that 'react to activity in a Kit account the moment it happens,' confirming trigger-based automation exists. However, evidence lacks detail on the actual rule-builder mechanics (trigger types, conditions, chained actions) or hands-on/independent confirmation of how automations behave. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automation rule structure/trigger-action logic, independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability.
